verdict.rationale: Ledgy's evidence describes generic 'one-click equity compliance reports', automated error flags and global mobility reporting. Nothing in the pack mentions Rule 701 disclosure thresholds, Form 3921 filings or 83(b) elections. Without any documentation of these US-specific filings being tracked or generated from the cap table, the generic compliance claims cannot be credited to this story.

support.subject: As an ops user, US equity compliance — Rule 701 disclosure thresholds, Form 3921 filings, 83(b) elections — is tracked and generated from the cap table automatically
